name: Paranormal Teens
source:
What happens when a conspiracy theorist, a demonologist, a psychic, an abductee, a Voodoo Queen, a paranormal investigator and a parapsychologist-in-training are brought together for a one-time TV show called Paranormal Teens?

Not quite what you'd expect when there are dark presences at bay, and plenty of conflict to keep them... occupied.

But if you mess with the supernatural, it often messes back.

[From [url=https://godline.itch.io/paranormal-teens]Itch.io[/url]]
